note: Limits and rules of the investment plan. The limits are monitored by the allocation model (models/igfinal/config.py); the buy and sell rules were set by the portfolio manager on 15 November 2026.
buy_criteria: Core, 70% of the fund: a replica of the S&P 500 with beta 1, made of 50 of its largest companies without NVDA. Its job is to follow the index; it is not a bet.
Sleeve, 30% of the fund: AMD, ASML, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, PLTR and BABA in equal parts, bought on 16 November and held until the Anthropic IPO.
A company wanted by both parts is held once, with the two weights added together.
Every order is approved by the portfolio manager and recorded in the trade log with its reason.
sell_criteria: The whole sleeve is sold on the day of the IPO, Thursday 19 November, after the New York open, even if the IPO is postponed. There is no earlier exit.
On Friday 20 November the cash from the sale is invested and the whole fund is brought back to the beta-1 replica.
From the following week the fund is brought back to its target weights every Friday before the open, always fully invested.
An order smaller than $10,000 (0.1% of the fund) is not placed: it costs a commission and changes almost nothing.
A breached limit on the dashboard is fixed before any other trade.
